decision: Accept the existing one-millionth-degree coordinate format for this dated administrative map. The exterior changes about 0.062 metres. Four hole components survive, but a very thin branch of hole4 collapses, covering about 11.55 square metres previously in that source gap. Exact source parts and unrounded union remain preserved; no gap filling or snapping is performed before the normal compiler rounding.
limitation: The approximately 87-metre all-ring Hausdorff value is the collapsed long thin interior branch, not an 87-metre displacement of the exterior. Packed geometry does not preserve every source gap exactly.
